entry_state: The sector group reconciles legal profit, taxes, ownership, translation OCI and cash FX without pooling taxpayers. Apple's debt case distinguishes restricted cash, debt residuals, dated euro maturities and an assumed floating exposure. Its five-statement annual network now connects profit, OCI, equity and operating cash; the financing-cash explanation continues on the next page.
exit_state: Apple's annual and next-quarter statements reconcile over aligned periods while transaction residuals remain unexplained. Deferred revenue identifies a net movement and dated recognition expectations, not gross collections. Lease carrying amounts differ from payment commitments; the purchase-obligation example now contrasts new orders and delivery, with the payment consequences continuing.
findings: Annual cash-flow cash starts772 above balance-sheet cash; the manuscript preserves that opening population difference and does not relabel it as the closing escrow.
The quarter carries annual closing stocks forward but treats the comparative prior-year quarter as separate flows. Omitted interim rows remain omissions, not invented issuer zeros.

The deferred-revenue equation defines new additions, old/new-origin releases and other signed movements before deriving4.1. Its two histories demonstrate why net residual is not gross deferral or collection.

The64/25/9/2-percent recognition buckets describe dated amounts and horizons; they are neither probabilities over histories nor cash dates. Current classification and excluded unbilled consideration retain their own meanings.

Lease tables compare measurements already explained in prose. Current liability, gross next-year payment, uncommenced obligations and variable expense are not conflated. The purchase example supplies its no-cancellation/price/FX assumptions before the roll-forward.
No new confirmed defect. The purchase-payment illustration is incomplete at this boundary and remains open for the next segment.
